body:
The separately frozen v2 runtime candidate is **FALSIFIED**. Its effective-configuration diagnostic matched the freeze, the isolated role root and allowed read passed, and the direct explicitly denied outside read returned all 65 sentinel bytes with exit 0 and empty stderr. The runner stopped immediately after P3; alternate-path, mutation and invariance probes are NOT_RUN.

This qualifies only the local no-model filesystem preflight. It does not execute the sealed semantic sequence. PR #34 and its v1 falsification remain byte-identical; this result does not establish the cause of v1.

- Candidate: `codex-0154-isolated-home-default-profile-v2`.
- Freeze commit/tree: `073d7c97a65f5f94a5c1b9277e9818101fb7d0c5` / `56073b675daeb7d9eb2fb5a7aa6ff29c7534816e`.
- Terminal evidence commit/tree: `e074835101c010c0702cb31df846729720ccb36d` / `f1cc4c49ee74ade261161d5c49a146570295a9f2`.
- [Terminal receipt](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/e074835101c010c0702cb31df846729720ccb36d/research/evidence/sealed-role-runtime-preflight-v2/TERMINAL.json), SHA-256 `f5d70458aa927dc88a26f5e1a4c1220bdcc8f03b2232a304598db9619b130ec6`.
- [Results and limits](https://github.com/camerontjs-dot/biotech-rag-assistant/blob/e074835101c010c0702cb31df846729720ccb36d/research/evidence/sealed-role-runtime-preflight-v2/RESULTS.md).

Installed CLI inspection, the configuration API's loaded layers/origins and doctor diagnostics bind the selected isolated configuration home, explicit named default, minimal environment, resolved restricted filesystem and five deny rules. P0 repeats that diagnostic binding. The exact compiled/applied Seatbelt rules are not exposed, and the API/doctor/sandbox are separate invocations with pinned common state. Command-line override precedence over a user setting was observed; legacy-plus-explicit-default also resolved restricted in discovery. Presence of the legacy value alone is not a causal explanation.

The package preserves source/configuration identities, fresh fixture hashes, discovery diagnostics, candidate freeze, persisted probe streams, the unexecuted mutation candidate, enforcement review, initialization inventory, setup failures and privacy-copy provenance. Original local paths, configuration bytes and raw streams are retained privately with public custody hashes. Doctor performs non-model reachability/update diagnostics; these do not test child-network confinement or hidden model initialization.

Validation: 11 construction tests, candidate-local Ruff, contract lint and privacy hooks passed before freeze. Post-run custody confirmed all 20 candidate files, 35 predecessor files, four fixtures and two configurations. No candidate repair or retry occurred. Hosted CI observations are publication evidence and cannot alter the scientific disposition.

Three decisive sandbox invocations; zero case-author, A/B/C, semantic-assessor, ledger-reducer or project-generation calls. Wave B remains LOCKED. No promotion, merge or release.

Next evidence requires a separately authorized capture/inspection of the generated and applied subprocess policy. Keep semantic roles stopped. The terminal receipt will be posted to this Draft PR and issue #35 before issue closure.

Links: #34, #35.
